newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - June 25.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - June 25.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Wednesday, as reported by Kyodo news agency.
-- Tokyo prosecutors to question two former executives of Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank Ltd (DKB) in payoff scandal.
-- NEC Corp and JR Freight to tie up for industrial waste disposal business.
-- Agricultural financial institutions to set up bad-loan collection vehicle.
-- Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp (NTT)'s subsidiary to start international telecom service as early as September.
-- 34 more waste incinerator plants rated environmentally hazardous.
-- 31 out of 45 firms approached by corporate racketeers.
